works.title: Mary Magdalena Voice / Moral Indictment Project
works.description: A new political voice and persona for moral/political indictment writing, developed for Substack publication. Uses somatic and visceral language techniques to bypass intellectual defenses and reach the body/heart. User plans to build a month-long inventory of prompt frameworks and publish under this distinct persona as part of a broader messaging strategy.
works.quote: I could spend a month building an inventory and refining the prompt framework. When I launch the Substack blog, I'll start with my first post being the about-me section

works.title: Ideological Critique Book: The Vulnerable Foundations of Conservative Power
works.description: A multi-part political analysis examining contradictions within the conservative coalition, particularly focusing on masculine identity deceptions and economic policy contradictions. Currently in active chapter drafting (chapter 15+) with extensive outlines and character development frameworks completed for all parts.
works.quote: Chapter 15 will be the first chapter in Part III: 'THE VULNERABLE FOUNDATIONS OF CONSERVATIVE POWER,' specifically focusing on 'Masculine Identity Contradiction.'

works.title: Cross-Tradition Pastoral-Prophetic Reference Dossier
works.description: A scholarly reference dossier on pastoral and prophetic concepts across religious traditions, written from a Mexican-American Catholic carpenter/medic perspective. Examines how historical religious figures view institutional power, betrayal, and moral response across Hindu, Buddhist, Islamic, Jewish, and Christian traditions.
works.quote: This is a substantial and well-defined dossier request... I have what I need to begin. Diving into the research now.

works.title: Generational Betrayal Dossier
works.description: A three-part reference companion using Taylor Swift's catalog as an analytical lens for generational/millennial critique, combined with Catholic social teaching and cultural-criticism sources. Explores work/family/capitalism contradiction and generational betrayal patterns in millennial experience.
works.quote: I'll build this dossier carefully. Let me start by reading the reference brief in full and then structuring the research approach. The file content is in the document context above.
